## Live Production Ecosystem (8 Flagship Products)

### 1. Khonshu — Agentic Quant Trading Terminal
- **Domain:** https://khonshu.ir/
- **Description:** Real-time crypto quantitative trading engine with low-latency Cortex WebSocket feeds, sub-20ms telemetry, algorithmic risk controls, and automated execution.
- **Tech Stack:** FastAPI, AsyncIO, WebSockets, Tailwind v4 (OKLCH color system), Python 3.12.

### 2. Najvagram — E2EE Anonymous Messaging Platform
- **Domain:** https://najvagram.ir/
- **Description:** High-security anonymous communication platform utilizing a train-compartment metaphor, zero-log policies, ephemeral access keys, and 12-tier progression gamification.
- **Tech Stack:** Flask, WebSockets, HKDF-derived AES-256 encryption, Redis pub/sub.

### 3. Lyraz — Collaborative Sound Grid & Music Bot
- **Domain:** https://lyraz.ir/landing
- **Description:** Multi-screen music streaming and room synchronization platform paired with Telegram bot integration, live synchronized lyrics, and 320kbps lossless audio.
- **Tech Stack:** Telegram Bot API, Web Audio API, WebSockets, Spotify API, Python.

### 4. DoneSpace — Household OS & Smart Chore Tracker
- **Domain:** https://donespace.ir/
- **Description:** Shared living productivity platform eliminating household chore friction through automated assignment queues, meal planning, and Google Calendar sync.
- **Tech Stack:** Python, Flask, Google Calendar API, PWA, PostgreSQL.

### 5. m0j (Life Architecture) — 8-Domain Identity Codex
- **Domain:** https://m0j.ir/
- **Description:** Self-actualization system scaffolding 8 human identity domains (Mind, Body, Skill, Relations, Experience, Adventure, Impact, Finance) into gamified quests.
- **Tech Stack:** FastAPI, SSE (Server-Sent Events), Chart.js, Spring Physics CSS.

### 6. AnkiSynth AI — Knowledge Forge & Flashcard Synthesizer
- **Domain:** https://mahdi0jafari.github.io/AnkiSynth/
- **Description:** Multi-turn AI knowledge distiller converting academic literature and lecture notes into atomic, high-retention spaced-repetition Anki decks.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 15, Google Gemini 3.1 API, Dexie.js (IndexedDB), APKG binary generator.

### 7. Fanus — Emotional Digital Sanctuary
- **Domain:** https://fanus-space.ir/
- **Description:** Night-time digital wall of thoughts and anonymous whispers featuring a nostalgic candlelight aesthetic and interactive community interactions.
- **Tech Stack:** Flask, SQLite WAL mode, Server-Sent Events, Vanilla CSS.

### 8. CoWorkMap × BlueWhite — Iran Coworking Directory
- **Domain:** http://coworkmap.ir/
- **Description:** Geospatial directory and booking system for over 340 coworking hubs across Iran with interactive Neshan navigation integration and direct reservation.
- **Tech Stack:** Vue 3, Vite, Vuetify, Neshan Maps API, GeoJSON.

## Technical Stack & Architecture Competencies
- **Backend & Cloud:** Python 3.12, FastAPI, AsyncIO, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, Docker, Nginx.

- **Artificial Intelligence:** LangGraph, Google Gemini 3.1, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Embeddings.
